purpose: Isolate whether a complete signed train-only ACF-profile seriation is useful for the variable-token MambaACF AutoCon forecaster, without changing the forecast memory, relation objective, or training budget.
research_question: At H96 on ETTh1 and Traffic, do ACF-profile similarity paths improve the same variable-token MambaACF AutoCon model relative to input order and dominant-peak strength order?
evidence_boundary: Unauthorized exploratory order ablation: two datasets, one horizon, three paired seeds, and validation-only metrics. It is not evidence for a learned graph, cross-correlation model, universal Mamba gain, or publication claim.
claim_boundary: The only estimand is the paired order effect under a fixed train-only ACF sidecar and fixed memory/relation path. A favorable order result must be replicated with permutation/reverse robustness and a separately reviewed confirmation plan.

seed_policy.reporting_unit: dataset, horizon, order arm, and seed
seed_policy.sidecar_policy: All three order arms in a coordinate must use the identical raw train-only compact/full ACF sidecar and hash. Only the deterministic order rule may differ.
seed_policy.artifact_policy: Use a fresh exploratory output root and retain source snapshot, environment, dataset hashes, plan hash, config hashes, manifest, sidecar, checkpoint, validation trajectory, and phase validation.

phases.name: order_input_h96
phases.purpose: Control: retain CSV channel order while keeping every ACF memory and AutoCon relation option fixed.

phases.name: order_strength_h96
phases.purpose: Ablation: deterministic dominant-|ACF| peak order under the identical forecast/relation path.

phases.name: order_similarity_h96
phases.purpose: Treatment: deterministic signed selected-lag ACF-profile cosine-seriation order under the identical forecast/relation path.

comparison_contract.order_contract: For each paired coordinate, sidecar hash, effective lags, model weights outside order-specific initialization, and training budget must match. The order is train-only metadata and must be replayable without reading validation/test windows.
comparison_contract.interpretation: A lower validation MSE is descriptive only. Also report identity rate, order stability across seeds, target-channel scan position, CPU order-build time, and input/reverse/random permutation sensitivity before considering replication.
comparison_contract.publication_claim_boundary: This screen cannot support a claim that ACF self-profiles recover cross-channel graph structure or that any order is universally superior.

resource_contract.order_build: Measure one-time CPU setup at C=7 and C=862; the helper uses O(C^2K) arithmetic and O(CK) memory and must not be charged as per-batch forward MACs.
resource_contract.forward: Measure identical prediction-only and prediction-plus-representation device-resident latency for all three arms; order should add zero steady-state trainable parameters and no dense similarity buffer.
resource_contract.end_to_end: No speed claim is allowed without matched forward+backward+optimizer+loader telemetry under one FP32/AMP and effective-batch contract.

stopping_rules: Do not launch while execution.authorized is false.
If the similarity helper produces a non-permutation, non-finite order, or sidecar replay mismatch, invalidate the coordinate instead of repairing it post hoc.
If similarity fails the predeclared validation gate or materially increases setup/resource cost, retain the simpler input-order model and stop order expansion.
Do not select an order from test metrics or add VPT/random/reverse arms after seeing this screen; register a new plan first.
A favorable order pattern is exploratory and requires an independent frozen replication.
